name: usbjiggler
title: USB Mouse Jiggler
desc: Turn an RG34XXSP running muOS 2 NeXT into a configurable USB HID mouse. Choose 1-300 second intervals, smooth 1-2000 pixel movement, and Horizontal, Vertical, Square, or Random patterns from the gamepad. The bundled provenance-gated module and reversible ConfigFS lifecycle require no kernel flashing.
inst: Extract the archive to the SD-card storage root, then launch USB Mouse Jiggler from Ports. Connect the RG34XXSP USB-C port to the host computer before starting movement.
